body:
```toml
[project]
name = "dep-playground"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.14"
dependencies = [
    "numpy<2.6>",
    "pandas<2.2.0"
]

[tool.uv]
no-build = true
package = false
```

The above errors with:

```
$ uv lock
Using CPython 3.13.2
error: Failed to generate package metadata for
       `dep-playground==0.1.0 @ virtual+.`
  Caused by: Building source distributions for `dep-playground` is
             disabled
```

The actual error is however a typo in the numpy declaration, which we should report. Instead, uv tries to heal the unparseable section through PEP 517, then fails because PEP 517 is disallowed. In a second problem, this ignored `tool.uv.package = false` which should have taken precedence.
title: Bad error message with parser error and no-build
